units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 1:1">Nidd. I, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 1:1">Eduy. I, 1</cite> <he>מפ׳ לפ׳</he> (her uncleanness dates back) from the present examination to the last one.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>הרי זו כפ׳</he> this is as good as an examination; a. fr.

senses.gloss: divine visitation (for good or for evil), remembrance, decree; use of the verb פָּקַד.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 91b:6">Snh. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>משעת פ׳</he> from the moment when it is decreed (what the embryonic germ should grow to be).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 42:1">Pesik. R. s. 42</cite> <he>יש פ׳ לברכה</he> there is a visitation (use of <he>פקד</he>) for blessing; <he>יש פ׳ של גאולה וכ׳</he> there is a visitation for redemption &c.; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:4">Num. R. s. 4</cite>, beg. (interch. with <cite ref="Q01457"><he>פְּקוּדָה</he></cite>).
R. Hash. 11ᵃ אתיא פ׳ פ׳ there is an analogy between paḳad (I Sam. II, 21) and paḳad (Gen. XXI, 1).

Ex. R. s. 5 סימן הפ׳ the password paḳad (Ex. III, 16, ref. to Gen. L, 24); שמעו הפ׳ they heard the announcement of remembrance (Ex. IV, 31); ויקדו על הפ׳ they bowed in gratitude for the announcement of remembrance; a. e.
